title: Uploads
steps: Open Trip photos. Drag an image from your desktop into it, or copy one and paste it: "Uploading …" shows where it goes, then becomes `![name](/uploads/name.png)`. Drop a PDF and it's a link, `[lease.pdf](/uploads/lease.pdf)`.
⌘⇧P, Upload a file…: pick one or more files, and their links go at the cursor.
⌘⇧P, Show uploads: every upload, newest first, with thumbnails for images. Click a name to open it in a new browser tab; Link here puts a link at the cursor in the note you're in.
Upload the same file again: it's kept once, under the same name. Upload a different file with a name that's taken: it gets a number, like photo-2.png.
Show history of everything: each upload is a change by you to `.common-ink/uploads.json`. Undo one, and its address stops working; redo brings it back.
Agents can upload too: the MCP tool `upload_file` (base64) and `common-ink upload <file>`.
